title: Organization: what matters most, paging first

message.text:
**Taken.** One organization card, paging first. Five steps, one at a time, each posted here before the next starts. Main tree for steps 1–4; the doc rewrites (step 5) go in a pool worktree.

**Step 1 now:** a Haiku minion lists every audit and open ask from the last week, with links. Cost: about $0.50.

**Step 1 done** ($0.41, Haiku): [the list](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/organization/scan/list.md), with 14 audits, 8 open asks and 4 paging items, each one linked.

**Step 2 now:** a Sonnet minion builds this card in three tiers: most important, secondary, one-offs. Every item links to its real page. Paging goes on top. Cost: about $1.50.

title: Page mastermind: what matters most, paging first

message.text:
**Renamed: Page mastermind.** Your 1:30 PM words are folded into [the brief](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/organization/requirements.md):

- **Step 3 ($4.50):** three Sonnet readers audit the docs as a new user.
  - core/Page tabs and the page skill
  - every way to make a page
  - layouts (standard / wide / fill) and `/imagine/`
  - Each reader suggests a tab structure.
- **Step 4 ($0.30):** I merge the three suggestions into one proposal, posted here as a Decision.
- **Steps 5–6:** the object card, then the doc rewrite, one tab at a time.

Step 2 (this card's three tiers) is still building.

**Step 2 done** ($1.79, Sonnet): the overview above, in three tiers plus the earlier audits. That is 37 links, and none of them is a sub-card.

**Step 3 now:** three Sonnet readers audit the paging docs as a new user. Each one suggests a structure for the tabs. Cost: about $4.50. Spent so far: $2.20.

**Step 3 done** ($2.31 for three Sonnet readers): [3a](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/organization/audit/3a.md) · [3b](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/organization/audit/3b.md) · [3c](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/organization/audit/3c.md).

**Decision (step 4):** [one structure for core/Page](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/organization/proposal.md)
- Two new top tabs: **Make a page** and **Layout**. **Old** moves last. No URL changes.
- The layout names are **Standard · Split · Columns · Floating page · Top-down shape**. Your *wide* and *fill* are already core words with other meanings, so the new names avoid a clash. The alternative is to rename core's words, which touches about a dozen callers. Overturn it here if you prefer that.
- The rewrite order is set by value per unit of space. Your 1:40 PM floating page is item 4.

**Step 5 next:** the object card, about $2. Spent so far: $4.51.

**Step 5 done: the object card is live.** On [core/Page › API](/framework/core/Page/api/) it now reads *Page intro · title = "Intro" · url = "/intro/"*, then the methods as chips. Every class can use it: [ux/Content/Object](/framework/ux/Content/Object/).

- It passed three fresh-eyes reviews and the smoke test, and is merged into michael/dev.
- Cost: $5.25 to build (over the $2 estimate) plus about $1.50 for the reviews.
- **Total spend so far: $21.37**, counting my own turns. That is over the plan, mostly from the review loop.

**Step 6 next:** the three cheapest, highest-value rewrites, in one Sonnet pass.
1. Readme: the four ways to make a page.
2. A *Choosing a layout* page.
3. The *Make a page* tab.

Cost: about $3, plus one review.

**Landed: Make a page and Layout tabs on core/Page, plus the object card.**

- [Make a page](/framework/core/Page/make/): the four ways, each with its live result under its code
- [Layout](/framework/core/Page/layout/): Standard · Split · Columns · Floating page · Top-down shape
- [API](/framework/core/Page/api/): the object card, *Page intro · title = "Intro"*

**Spent $36, about 3× the plan.** Three rounds of review on one branch are most of the overrun. So I stopped here.

[The next pass](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/organization/rewrite/next-pass.md) is written but **not started**:
- the Floating page demo
- a Top-down shape page
- trimming columns.md

Say *go* on this card to run it: about $3.65.
